verdict.rationale: BILL documents an official MCP server that agents like Cursor, Windsurf and Claude Desktop can connect to, but it only exposes the BILL API documentation. Nothing in the evidence shows agents can use it to read or act on Spend & Expense data such as cards, budgets, transactions or reimbursements. missing for 10: an MCP server exposing Spend & Expense data and actions, auth/setup details for an operational MCP endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.
